title: Hot water, AC condensers and clotheslines maintainable, not obtrusive, not impeding outdoor living or storage
text: Hot water units, air-conditioning condenser units and clotheslines are located such that they can be safely maintained, are not visually obtrusive from the street and do not impact on functionality of outdoor living areas or internal storage.
notes: from: ch4p1 C2.5.2 (functional utilities); diverges: performance wording, judgment here.
